name: Pharr (United States)
description: White field charged with the city logo, a blue and yellow emblem of the Pharr–Reynosa International Bridge beside the name Pharr in blue.
history: Pharr is a city in Hidalgo County, Texas, at the Pharr–Reynosa International Bridge. Flags of the World records this logo flag in use since at least 2010 alongside a flag with the seal designed in 2009, and a newer flag with a logo introduced in 2019.

features.role: bridge emblem and the name Pharr
